fact: At the sixth multi-sectoral AI strategy meeting on 3 November 2026, progress was presented on a language model specialised in Algerian tax legislation, with 98% of the relevant legal documents collected, and implementation of the data and infrastructure plan is scheduled to begin on 11 November 2026.
title: Minister of higher education and scientific research chairs the sixth multi-sectoral meeting to monitor the implementation of the national artificial intelligence strategy
publisher: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (Algeria)
